name: Tasogare no Saki ni Noboru Ashita -Applique FanDisc-
original_name: 黄昏の先にのぼる明日 -あっぷりけFanDisc-
source:
Fandisk for Applique’s Miageta Sora ni Ochiteiku, Concerto Note and Tasogare no Sinsemilla. There are three after stories (one from each series), as well as three side stories and online mahjong.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/12/01/december-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
Applique旗下《仰望的天空坠落》《Concerto Note》与《黄昏的禁忌之药》的合集资料片。收录三个系列各一篇后日谈、三篇支线故事，以及在线麻将模式。

[译自 [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/12/01/december-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
